changelog.change: Initial shape: the input position, the three addresses and the registrar.
changelog.why: The import needs a declared row before it writes one.

description:
One line of the supplied URL list, as one element of `manifest.json`.

`source_line` is here because the list is the deliverable's input and a
person reading a refusal needs the line to look at. Two lines carrying
equivalent addresses keep both rows and share one `url_key`, so the count of
rows and the count of identities are different numbers on purpose.

canonical_url.description: What `url_key` is derived from, never trusted from a payload.
canonical_url.title: Canonical Url

publisher.description: The outlet key a balanced sample groups on, frozen at import. Derived from the host rather than the registered domain, and lengthened only where two hosts would otherwise share it.
publisher.title: Publisher

source_domain.description: The registered domain, which is the unit the frozen set separates on.
source_domain.title: Source Domain

source_id.description: Which feed in `config/sources.json` this host is, when exactly one is. Null is 'we do not know', and a host shared by feeds in two verticals stays null.
source_id.title: Source Id

source_line.description: The 1-based line of the input file this row came from.
source_line.title: Source Line

source_url.description: The address as supplied, kept so a person can open it.
source_url.title: Source Url

url_key.description: sha256 of the canonical URL, recomputed on read.
url_key.title: Url Key

vertical.description: Source context from the feed's declaration, never a reading of the article. Null rather than a word invented for the taxonomy.
vertical.title: Vertical

title: ReferenceManifestRow
